name: 15w vocabulary size comparison
title: Comparing a 32,000 and a 128,000 token vocabulary
subtitle: Reference 7B model; 1,000 words of held-out chat text

steps.caption: Measure tokens per word: 1.316 at 32,000 and 1.261 at 128,000 on the same text.
Each token costs 13.21 billion FLOPs at 32,000 and 14.00 billion at 128,000.
With 15% fewer tokens the bigger vocabulary costs about 0.90 of the smaller one.
Training stores 4,096 x V logits as 4-byte numbers for every sequence.
Four times as many rows share slightly fewer tokens, so each row is seen far less often.
